items.name: PPO harness at fixed D3 hyperparameters
items.criterion: optspread.train exposes a train_ppo entry point and one pinned frozen_hyperparameters record (D3) whose values equal the installed Stable-Baselines3 defaults (its matches_library is True; not installed is not a pass); and at least one PPO run (policy ppo with a training config) under the runs root has a valid manifest
items.evidence: 21 pinned values, hash 628d9ce46772fd0e, equal to the stable-baselines3 2.9.0 defaults; 16 PPO run(s) under $VEGALAB_DATA/runs/pilot

items.name: Deterministic replay from hash
items.criterion: optspread.replay.replay_matches re-runs a recorded run from its manifest (config hash and seed) and reproduces every artifact digest the manifest records; one PPO run and one scripted run are replayed when both kinds are under the runs root, at least one run in any case
items.evidence: replayed 1a220aad9011acb8-s4600 (PPO, 2 artifacts) and 03e0b95e5ad61a4c-s4200 (scripted, 1 artifacts) of 32 runs (16 PPO, 16 scripted) under $VEGALAB_DATA/runs/pilot; digests match

items.name: Variance-components pilot
items.criterion: the pilot's S x N contrast matrices (matrix.npy, PPO at the pilot premium minus PPO at zero, and matrix_oracle.npy, the fixed-delta seller's same contrast; the pre-registered detection event of #26) sit beside a valid manifest that records both digests and whose config is the PPO arm with its training config; S >= 5, N >= 20, every entry finite, N equal to the manifest's n_episodes and S to the grid's seed count where the grid record is present; tau^2 and sigma^2 of the PPO contrast (what the pre-registered test tests) are reported with standard errors beside the seller's, and turned into the exact noncentral-t detection floor at one-sided alpha = 0.05 and 80% power
items.evidence: 8 x 200 pilot (run 389cb8489134dd1b-s4000, 1,000,000 training steps per seed, grid of 8 seeds): contrast ppo at 1 - ppo at 0 tau^2 = 5.184e+04 (se 3.116e+05), sigma^2 = 1.06e+08 (se 3.757e+06); delta_seller at 1 - at 0 tau^2 = 1,026 (se 2,767), sigma^2 = 8.286e+05 (se 2.937e+04); exact-t detection floor of the PPO contrast at N = 200: 1,037 at S = 5, 272 at S = 50

items.name: Analysis pipeline validated against a known analytic case
items.criterion: at every effect on the grid, including delta = 0 where the answer is alpha, the decision rule's rejection rate over R paired synthetic replications lies within 4 Monte Carlo standard errors, sqrt(p (1 - p) / R), of the closed-form noncentral-t power at the hand-specified tau^2, sigma^2 and delta; and the mean estimated sigma^2 and Var(grand mean) lie within 4 standard errors of their true values; and each deliberately wrong rule (normal critical values, unpaired arms, episodes as independent) fails the same check; and in the null world (a flat learner, a control paying a cost drag of 5, nothing planted) the pre-registered event, each arm against itself at zero premium, fires within the same tolerance of alpha while the event it replaced (the learner against the fixed-delta seller at one premium) does not
items.evidence: tau^2 = 4, sigma^2 = 100, shared path variance 400, S = 10 x N = 25, one-sided alpha = 0.05; R = 10,000 per effect; rejection rate/closed form: 0.047/0.050 at 0, 0.127/0.130 at 0.5, 0.275/0.271 at 1, 0.662/0.662 at 2, 0.927/0.925 at 3; largest deviation -1.47 MC se (rejection rate at delta = 0); 3 of 3 wrong rules refused; the normal approximation reads 0.723 against 0.662 at delta = 2; null world: each arm against itself at zero premium fires at 0.050 against alpha = 0.05 (+0.05 MC se), the learner against the fixed-delta seller at one premium at 0.995

items.name: Pre-registration committed and tagged
